messages:
noah: Follow-up from the authz postmortem: rotation job skipped a pattern group after the cleanup. Need a tight remediation list with owners and dates.

talia: Short plan: (A) make rotation idempotent + canary, (B) add recurring audit for long-lived tokens, (C) update runbook + emergency rotate.

ben: I'll own (A) rotation hardening (TASK-801). Deliverables: preflight validator, canary flag, rotation_success/fail metrics. ETA 2026-04-07.

noah: I'll take (B) recurring audit + alerts (TASK-802). Draft Splunk query + dashboard tile by 2026-03-30. Alert on TTL>60d and legacy secret paths.

talia: I'll do (C) runbook and manual remediation checklist (TASK-803). Draft and emergency command snippets by 2026-03-28.

incident-bot: Created board items: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/authz-followup  (TASK-801, TASK-802, TASK-803).

ben: Manual rotation tonight: svc-payments ok, svc-billing ok, svc-telemetry failed until infra remapped secret path. Logs: ```rot svc-payments ok
rot svc-billing ok
rot svc-telemetry failed: legacy path```

security-eng: Running inventory scan for legacy secret paths and tokens ttl>60d. Will attach CSV and mark blockers.

noah: Add rule: rotation_failures > 0 for 2 runs -> pager. Also include a daily audit job that writes token inventory to S3.

talia: Splunk WIP: ```index=auth_logs | where ttl_days>60 OR secret_path LIKE "%/secret/legacy%" | stats count by service, token_id``` Will add alert and dashboard tile.

ben: PR will add rotation metrics and a CI e2e that injects bad regex to ensure failures fail the pipeline (PR-4720).

noah: Ownership summary: TASK-801 -> ben -> 2026-04-07; TASK-802 -> noah -> draft 2026-03-30; TASK-803 -> talia -> 2026-03-28. Short sync Mon 2026-03-31 09:00 PT (10m). Target closure 2026-04-15 if audits pass.

ops-bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood.link/pm-authz-2026
